cards.ex: I need to flesh out my essay with more examples to support my claims.
cards.exUz: Men da'volarimni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun inshomni ko'proq misollar bilan to'ldirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: G'oyani yoki rejani batafsil tushuntirish, to'ldirish.

cards.ex: The committee spent hours hammering out the details of the new policy.
cards.exUz: Qo'mita yangi siyosat tafsilotlari bo'yicha kelishib olish uchun soatlab vaqt sarfladi.

cards.ex: The introduction sets the stage for a deeper discussion of the topic.
cards.exUz: Kirish so'z mavzuni chuqurroq muhokama qilish uchun asos yaratadi.

cards.ex: I struggled to get my point across in the meeting.
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishda fikrimni yetkazishga qiynaldim.

cards.ex: Whether or not he attended the conference is now a moot point, since the project is finished.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tugallangandan so'ng, uning konferentsiyada qatnashgan yoki qatnashmagani endi bahsli masala.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan, ammo amalda ahamiyati yo'q masala.

cards.ex: In the wake of the scandal, the CEO resigned.
cards.exUz: Janjal oqibatida bosh direktor iste'foga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror hodisadan keyin yuzaga kelgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The research proposal fell short of the required standards.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot taklifi talab qilinadigan standartlarga javob bermadi.

cards.ex: He was promoted by virtue of his hard work and dedication.
cards.exUz: U o'zining mashaqqatli mehnati va sadoqati sababli lavozimga ko'tarildi.

cards.ex: The study was conducted with the aim of understanding the effects of climate change.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot iqlim o'zgarishining oqibatlarini tushunish maqsadi bilan o'tkazildi.

cards.ex: The company is on the cusp of a major breakthrough.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya katta yutuq arafasida.

cards.ex: His line of reasoning was flawed, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
cards.exUz: Uning muhokama usuli noto'g'ri bo'lib, noto'g'ri xulosaga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ishlatiladigan fikrlash usuli.

cards.ex: We need to improve our communication; to that end, we're implementing new strategies.
cards.exUz: Biz aloqalarimizni yaxshilashimiz kerak; shu maqsadda biz yangi strategiyalarni amalga oshirmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: His optimism was in stark contrast to her pessimism.
cards.exUz: Uning optimizmi uning pessimizmiga keskin zid edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi katta va aniq farq.

cards.ex: This final product is a far cry from our original concept.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yakuniy mahsulot bizning asl konsepsiyamizdan juda uzoq.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa kutilgan yoki avvalgi holatdan juda farq qiladi.

cards.ex: We need to iron out the remaining issues before the presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimotdan oldin qolgan muammolarni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish yoki bartaraf etish.

cards.ex: The success of the project hinges on securing funding.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyati moliyalashtirishni ta'minlashga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaning muvaffaqiyati yoki natijasi boshqa narsaga bog'liq bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The positive feedback spurred her on to continue her research.
cards.exUz: Ijobiy fikr-mulohazalar uni tadqiqotlarini davom ettirishga undadi.

cards.ex: The article brings to the fore the ethical implications of AI.
cards.exUz: Maqola sun'iy intellektning axloqiy oqibatlarini diqqat markaziga olib chiqadi.

cards.ex: Creativity is at the heart of innovation.
cards.exUz: Ijodkorlik innovatsiyaning markazida turadi.

cards.ex: In view of the evidence, we must conclude that...
cards.exUz: Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, biz shunday xulosaga kelishimiz kerakki...
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani hisobga olib, e'tiborga olgan holda.

cards.ex: Shakespeare's plays have stood the test of time.
cards.exUz: Shekspirning pyesalari vaqt sinovidan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida yaxshi sifatini saqlab qolmoq.

cards.ex: These courses fall under the umbrella of humanities.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kurslar gumanitar fanlar qamrab olgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta guruh yoki toifaning bir qismi.

cards.ex: The speaker drew a parallel between the two historical events.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruzachi ikki tarixiy voqea o'rtasida o'xshashlik topdi.

cards.ex: We need to take into account all the factors before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin barcha omillarni hisobga olishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: In the grand scheme, this is a relatively minor problem.
cards.exUz: Umumiy manzarada bu nisbatan kichik muammo.

cards.ex: The author makes a strong case for investing in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Muallif qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga sarmoya kiritishni qattiq himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biron g'oya yoki fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlamoq, himoya qilmoq.

cards.ex: On closer inspection, the document revealed some inconsistencies.
cards.exUz: Diqqat bilan tekshirilganda, hujjatda ba'zi nomuvofiqliklar aniqlandi.

cards.ex: His argument begs the question of how we will fund the project.
cards.exUz: Uning bahsi loyihani qanday moliyalashtirishimiz haqidagi savolni tug'diradi.

cards.ex: It's frustrating when they keep moving the goalposts for project approval.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tasdiqlash uchun qoidalarni o'zgartirib tursa, bu asabiylashadi.

cards.ex: We conducted the investigation with due diligence to ensure accuracy.
cards.exUz: Aniqlikni ta'minlash uchun biz tergovni ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Hamma zarur choralarni ko'rib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan.
